game.q: the angry songs. how do most of them end?
opts: with a slammed door and no answer
turning back to trust in God
with a subtweet at the enemy

wrong.dark: a few do. psalm 88 ends in the dark. most don’t.
wrong.petty: petty, but no. most land on trust.

game.right: YES. most laments turn to trust before they end. you only shout at someone you believe is listening.

end.line: hunted and hiding, he asked God “how long?” and was still talking to him at the end.
end.l1: hunted, he asked God: how long?

cliff.s1: next: the sign on every church wall.
cliff.s2: it was once a sign of shame.

share: hunted. hiding. angry at God, and he said it out loud. the psalms on infinite hill
